sources.title: Tencent Opens the Weights of a 770B Model — US Labs Close, Chinese Labs ...
sources.snippet: Tencent has released Hy4 preview, a next-generation large language model, and opened its weights. The model carries 770 billion total parameters with 49 billion active, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. That mixture-of-experts design keeps the model large while activating only about 6% of it per forward pass — scale without the inference bill that usually comes with it.
